result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred position because Vendor may assign without consent to an affiliate or successor and there is no prohibition on assignment to a Customer competitor. It also exceeds the fallback, which permits consent-free assignment only to successors, by granting both parties an additional affiliate-assignment right and by including the broader concept of a reorganisation. The existing consent standard remains intact for other assignments, and no Vendor termination right is introduced. The drafting is otherwise clear and preserves unrelated subcontracting and transfer restrictions.
